description: Watch OMP subagents work instead of staring at a "Ran tool" row. Each spawn gets a live line per agent under it in the dialog, and the thread header opens a panel with every agent's status, model, tokens, cost, transcript and final output. A box in the panel messages the OMP session, and a bb omp-subagents command gives agents the same view. Requires threads on the omp provider and the omp CLI on the machine that runs them.
